title: Momoi Airi — Intro To Tea Ceremony〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I think we've got our new formation totally down!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and this seems like a good place to stop our morning practice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Whew, I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You did come here very early this morning to practice, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been so long since we last practiced on the rooftop that I couldn't help but feel excited!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It did snow a lot recently, which led to it being closed off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Thankfully, we got to practice using one of the stages in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it's supposed to be sunny all day today, so we should be able to practice up here after school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Yay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
About practicing after school...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was hoping to stop by my club today, so I won't be able to make it today. Sorry, I know this is pretty sudden.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see... But it is important to stay active in our various clubs. So, Airi, please have fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll handle things here and promise to work extra hard while you're gone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. So no need to worry, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Message received.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I'll need to make up for the time I'll be losing by practicing on my own later.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're in the tea ceremony club, right, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The tea ceremony club... It sounds nice to get to have good tea and have nice snacks to go along with it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, having tea and snacks is a part of the ceremony, but focusing on that means you're sort of missing the quintessential point of our club.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Q-Quintessential point...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! Tea ceremonies require you to know how to use each item properly, have a good understanding of etiquette and be in the right state of mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In other words, it's meant to be a work of art!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Whoa!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, I'm not really in a position to be saying that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A part of me wanted to know how tea ceremonies worked, but another part of me was hoping to have some tasty treats.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, actually taking part has taught me a lot. It's actually really interesting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's quite a bit of history behind it as well. Which aspect of it did you find the most appealing, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well... Tea ceremonies have different styles, like martial arts. For instance, depending on your style, the etiquette and the bowls and utensils you use can differ greatly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The teacher usually teaches us the style they studied, but we also invite practitioners of other styles and have them teach us from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow... It sounds like you have to learn so much...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I actually really enjoy learning about all these different styles.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I want to go today because we get to speak with one of those visitors today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means this is a special day for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, it sort of is.
Not only that, I heard that we get to see some really rare tea bowls, so I'm really looking forward to seeing them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Were they made by somebody famous?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, some of them apparently were.
Also, it's fun to see how ceramic objects differ depending on where they were fired.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Obviously, no two really look the same, but they also usually feel different in your hand in terms of weight and texture.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-The way you're talking, Airi... You sound like an expert!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, Airi, what kind of tea bowl is your favorite?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: My favorite...? I think I like bowls that feel bumpy but have a glossy glaze. To me, those seem the most unique and have the most presence.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: G-Glaze...? Presence...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You know how ceramics usually look all smooth and shiny? Glaze is essentially glass, which gives it that effect.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's called glaze?
That's good to know!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have a vague picture in my head of the kind of bowl you just described, but it'd be nice sometime to actually see one...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, you should!
Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to go into so much detail...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seemed to really enjoy talking about this, which put smiles on all our faces.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, your eyes sparkled while you talked.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A-Anyway!
Today, club activities will be taking priority over practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course! I hope you have fun, Airi.
